# Registration
Registration for ISC Biotrop 2026 is open. Please stay tuned for further updates on this page.
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .text_block}
For early inquiries or to express your interest, feel free to contact us at: [admin@iscbiotrop.org](mailto:admin@iscbiotrop.org)

### Course Packages

| Facilities | International Students | Local Students | Online Participant |
|------------|---|---|---|
| Lectures from Experts | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☑️ |
| Hands on Bioinformatics Analysis | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☑️ |
| Hands on GIS Analysis | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☑️ |
| Field Trips | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☐ |
| Next-Generation Sequencing sample preparation | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☐ |
| Accomodation and Transport during Field Trips | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☐ |
| Summer Course Kit | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☐ |
| Meals during classes and fieldtrips | ☑️ | ☑️ | ☐ |
| Airport train tickets | ☑️ | ☐ | ☐ |
: {.striped .hover}

::: {.callout-important}
- <small>Health insurance are not covered. All participants are encouraged to apply for health insurance individually.</small>
- <small>Flight or transportation of arrival and departure from Yogyakarta</small>
- <small>SIM Card and Internet data package, Laundry service, Dinners outside of class and field trips, and Personal-related expenses.</small>
- <small>Please refer to this [page](/program/ncp){target="_blank"} for the facilities given to the **NCP 4 Weeks Program** participants.</small>
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .full_text_block}
### International and ASEAN students

1. All international participants (**online** and **onsite**) must first register via Office of International Affairs (OIA) [**Admission site**](https://admissions.ugm.ac.id/enrollment/public/) to get Letter of Offer (includes billing details) and Letter of Acceptance issued by the OIA of Universitas Gadjah Mada.
2. Required documents for registration are:
    - Color scanned Passport (`.JPG` max 2MB)
    - Pass photo (`.pdf` max 2MB) (white background, the shoulder must appear in the photo)
3. Participants are also required to fill in [Registration Form](http://ugm.id/RegistrationISC2026) for important and detailed information. The form consists of:
    - Personal information
    - CV and motivation letter (suggested in PDF)
    - Health records and Dietary restrictions
    - Additional facilities
    - Proof of OIA Admission Registration for International participant (Screen shot of Enrollment History `.pdf`/`.jpeg`/`.png` max 2MB).

:::{.text-center}
[👉 OIA Admission Site](https://admissions.ugm.ac.id/enrollment/public/){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [👉 Registration Form](http://ugm.id/RegistrationISC2026){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

:::

<div></div>

::: {.g-col-12 .full_text_block}
### Indonesian Participants

1. Local participants are only required to fill in the [registration form](http://ugm.id/RegistrationISC2026Local). The form consists of:
    - Personal Information
    - CV and motivation letter (suggested in PDF)
    - Health records and Dietary restriction form
2. Once submitted, the application will be processed for review.
3. Payment details will be provided via email after the selection process.

:::{.text-center}
[👉 Registration Form](http://ugm.id/RegistrationISC2026Local){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::

:::

<div></div>

::: {.g-col-12 .full_text_block}
### Biodiversity Summit

1. Fill in registration form.
2. Payment via Bank Transfer or QRIS (in the registration form).
3. Upload proof of payment.
4. Optional: Submit your essay for a chance to win a prize! More information in the [Summit Page](/program/summit){target="_blank"}

:::{.text-center}
[👉 Registration Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfFgJEC17ZCogZMf-j7UX_8wrta6OOLPpyjCjm4MuBhV4q2cg/viewform){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
:::
